ModMetadata.Name: StationeersTabletHotkey
ModMetadata.Author: Lacyway
ModMetadata.Description:
[b]WARNING:[/b] This is a StationeersLaunchPad Plugin Mod. It requires BepInEx to be installed with the StationeersLaunchPad plugin. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
This mods allow you to key bind the switch cartridge button in your Advanced Tablet using the in-game controls menu to a key of your liking (defaults to Numpad0).
